payload.message:
Run the daily trading bot scan: cd ~/trading-bot && source .venv/bin/activate && python main.py

After it completes, read the last 30 lines of ~/trading-bot/logs/trades.log and send a summary to the user via Telegram. Include: which stocks were scanned, any that triggered signals, and whether any trades were placed. Keep it concise — 3-5 lines max. If there were no signals, just say 'No signals today. All 12 stocks scanned.'
